title:
Share with less friction.
Connect on your terms.
description: A home for the links you want to share. Set clear access steps and keep the destination private until your visitors finish them.
developmentDetail: SlimeXlink is being built. Accounts, link creation and unlocking have not been released yet.
statusDescription: Features will be released once they are connected to real data and fully tested.
platformDetail: A dark interface, Vietnamese and English, built for phones and desktops.
accountsDetail: Sign in, manage your links and set up access steps.
unlockDetail: Open each task, wait for the required time, then return to continue.
honesty: Access steps record opening a link; they do not verify follows or channel subscriptions.
errorDetail: Something went wrong. Please try again, or return to the home page if the problem continues.
notFoundDetail: This address does not exist or has changed. You can return to the home page to continue.
